units.title: 与、啦、于
units.intro: HSK 6, words 1–41, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 与其让我在他手下干，我宁愿辞职。
ex.p: yǔ qí ràng wǒ zài tā shǒu xià gàn wǒ nìng yuàn cí zhí
ex.en: I would rather quit than work under him.

ex.zh: 您觉得您无法与他人交流吗？
ex.p: nín jué de nín wú fǎ yú tā rén jiāo liú ma
ex.en: Do you feel like you can't connect with other people?

ex.zh: “你什么时候回来呀？”“看一下天气怎么样再说啦。”
ex.p: nǐ shén me shí hou huí lai ya kàn yī xià tiān qì zěn me yàng zài shuō lā
ex.en: "When will you be back?" "It all depends on the weather."

ex.zh: 你把我当什么啦？
ex.p: nǐ bǎ wǒ dāng shén me lā
ex.en: Who do you think I am?

ex.zh: 这就是我关于他知道的一切。
ex.p: zhè jiù shì wǒ guān yú tā zhī dào de yī qiè
ex.en: That is all I know about him.

ex.zh: 会议将在后天于东京举行。
ex.p: huì yì jiāng zài hòu tiān yú dōng jīng jǔ xíng
ex.en: The conference is to be held in Tokyo the day after tomorrow.

ex.zh: 你如果需要雨伞，那我借你一把。
ex.p: nǐ rú guǒ xū yào yǔ sǎn nà wǒ jiè nǐ yī bǎ
ex.en: If you need an umbrella I'll lend you one.

ex.zh: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ bù néng yǒu hái zi nǐ zǒng néng lǐng yǎng
ex.en: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.

ex.zh: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。
ex.p: wǒ men zhǐ huì zài nà yàng de tiáo jiàn xià tóng yì
ex.en: We will only consent on that condition.

ex.zh: 我没有一个同学住在这儿附近。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī gè tóng xué zhù zài zhèr fù jìn
ex.en: None of my classmates live near here.

ex.zh: 他更愿意工作而不是无所事事。
ex.p: tā gēng yuàn yì gōng zuò ér bù shì wú suǒ shì shì
ex.en: He preferred working to doing nothing.

ex.zh: 你必须在到期前完成这项工作。
ex.p: nǐ bì xū zài dào qī qián wán chéng zhè xiàng gōng zuò
ex.en: You must get the job done before the deadline.

items.en: to have sth to do with; to relate to; related to

ex.zh: 两者没有关联。
ex.p: liǎng zhě méi yǒu guān lián
ex.en: There is no connection between them.

ex.zh: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。
ex.p: shì gù sì hū hé hòu hòu de jī xuě yǒu guān
ex.en: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.

ex.zh: 你不能把你的东西搬去另一个房间吗？
ex.p: nǐ bù néng bǎ nǐ de dōng xī bān qù lìng yī gè fáng jiān ma
ex.en: Can't you move your stuff to the other room?

ex.zh: 她的房子在河的另一边。
ex.p: tā de fáng zi zài hé de lìng yī biān
ex.en: Her house is across the river.

ex.zh: 你要告诉我你到底想让我干嘛。
ex.p: nǐ yào gào sù wǒ nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng ràng wǒ gàn má
ex.en: You need to tell me what you want me to do.

ex.zh: “你去日本干嘛？”“去东京参加一个会议。”
ex.p: nǐ qù rì běn gàn má qù dōng jīng cān jiā yī gè huì yì
ex.en: "Why are you going to Japan?" "To attend a conference in Tokyo."

items.en: to exceed; to overtake; to surpass

ex.zh: 这里附近有超市吗？
ex.p: zhè lǐ fù jìn yǒu chāo shì ma
ex.en: Is there a supermarket nearby?

ex.zh: 她在超市做秘书。
ex.p: tā zài chāo shì zuò mì shū
ex.en: She is a clerk in the supermarket.

ex.zh: 因为下雪了，我什么也没能看见。
ex.p: yīn wèi xià xuě le wǒ shén me yě méi néng kàn jiàn
ex.en: Because of the snow, I couldn't see anything.

ex.zh: 底特律因它的汽车工业而出名。
ex.p: de tè lǜ yīn tā de qì chē gōng yè ér chū míng
ex.en: Detroit is famous for its car industry.

ex.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。
ex.p: wàn yī chuán yùn chí le wǒ men yǒu tè bié de chí dào bǎo xiǎn
ex.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.

ex.zh: 没发生什么特别的事。
ex.p: méi fā shēng shén me tè bié de shì
ex.en: Nothing special happened.

items.en: to enter; to go into; to join

ex.zh: 我不知到我爸的年收入是多少。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ bà de nián shōu rù shì duō shǎo
ex.en: I don't know my father's annual income.

ex.zh: 我们很快就可以安排您入座。
ex.p: wǒ men hěn kuài jiù kě yǐ ān pái nín rù zuò
ex.en: We can seat you soon.

items.en: Wow!; sound of a child's crying; sound of vomiting

ex.zh: 我觉得一般滑板比轮滑鞋便宜。
ex.p: wǒ jué de yī bān huá bǎn bǐ lún huá xié biàn yí
ex.en: I think skateboards are usually cheaper than rollerblades.

ex.zh: 自那以后他便过起了艰难的生活。
ex.p: zì nà yǐ hòu tā biàn guò qǐ le jiān nán de shēng huó
ex.en: He led a hard life after that.

ex.zh: 那个男人最终供认了他的罪行。
ex.p: nà gè nán rén zuì zhōng gōng rèn le tā de zuì xíng
ex.en: The man finally confessed.

ex.zh: 我最终得到了我要的那本书。
ex.p: wǒ zuì zhōng dé dào le wǒ yào de nà běn shū
ex.en: I finally got hold of that book I wanted.

ex.zh: 他不再是以前的那个他了。
ex.p: tā bù zài shì yǐ qián de nà gè tā le
ex.en: He is not what he used to be.

ex.zh: 我们被要求不再这么做。
ex.p: wǒ men bèi yāo qiú bù zài zhè me zuò
ex.en: We've been asked to not do this anymore.

ex.zh: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。
ex.p: wǒ men cháng bǎ hēi sè gēn sǐ wáng lián xì qǐ lai
ex.en: We often associate black with death.

ex.zh: 交通事故是美国青少年死亡的主要原因。
ex.p: jiāo tōng shì gù shì měi guó qīng shào nián sǐ wáng de zhǔ yào yuán yīn
ex.en: Car accidents are the leading cause of death for teenagers in the United States.

ex.zh: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。
ex.p: gēn jù tiān qì yù bào yǔ jì xià zhōu huì kāi shǐ
ex.en: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.

ex.zh: 据我所知，他没做错任何事。
ex.p: jù wǒ suǒ zhī tā méi zuò cuò rèn hé shì
ex.en: As far as I know, he did nothing wrong.

items.en: Qing (Wade-Giles: Ch'ing) dynasty of imperial China (1644-1911)

ex.zh: 他就算带了眼镜也看得不很清楚。
ex.p: tā jiù suàn dài le yǎn jìng yě kàn de bù hěn qīng chu
ex.en: Even with his glasses, he doesn't see very well.

ex.zh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。
ex.p: rú guǒ tā shì qīng bái de nà tā qī zǐ jiù yǒu zuì
ex.en: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.

ex.zh: 汤姆投票弃权。
ex.p: tāng mǔ tóu piào qì quán
ex.en: Tom abstained from voting.

items.en: to commit a crime; crime; offense

ex.zh: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。
ex.p: fàn zuì xiàn chǎng yǒu sān míng chuān zhì fú de jǐng chá
ex.en: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.

ex.zh: 这个犯罪和我一点关系都没有。
ex.p: zhè gè fàn zuì hé wǒ yī diǎn guān xi dōu méi yǒu
ex.en: I have nothing to do with the crime.

ex.zh: 我们被逼得走投无路了。
ex.p: wǒ men bèi bī de zǒu tóu wú lù le
ex.en: We were driven to the wall.

ex.zh: 我知道原因，但我不能告诉你。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào yuán yīn dàn wǒ bù néng gào sù nǐ
ex.en: I know the reason, but I can't tell you.

ex.zh: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。
ex.p: nà jiù shì wǒ bù zàn tóng nǐ de jì huà de yuán yīn
ex.en: That's why I don't approve of your plan.

ex.zh: 我们的朋友完成了比赛，得了第二名。
ex.p: wǒ men de péng you wán chéng le bǐ sài dé le dì èr míng
ex.en: Our friend finished the race in second place.

ex.zh: 那场比赛，我从头看到尾。
ex.p: nà cháng bǐ sài wǒ cóng tóu kàn dào wěi
ex.en: I watched the game from beginning to end.

items.en: to gather; to collect; collected works

ex.zh: 很快人群就在他周围聚集了起来。
ex.p: hěn kuài rén qún jiù zài tā zhōu wéi jù jí le qǐ lai
ex.en: A crowd soon gathered around him.

ex.zh: 一群人聚集在现场。
ex.p: yī qún rén jù jí zài xiàn chǎng
ex.en: A crowd gathered at the scene.

ex.zh: 它是基本人权。
ex.p: tā shì jī běn rén quán
ex.en: It's a basic human right.

ex.zh: 我也有权讲话。
ex.p: wǒ yě yǒu quán jiǎng huà
ex.en: I have the right to speak, too.

items.en: to the greatest extent; to be within the limits of; to give priority to

ex.zh: “你明天会来我的聚会吗？”“我尽量来。”
ex.p: nǐ míng tiān huì lái wǒ de jù huì ma wǒ jǐn liàng lái
ex.en: "Will you be at my party tomorrow night?" "I'll try to be there."

ex.zh: 你做任何事都要尽全力。
ex.p: nǐ zuò rèn hé shì dōu yào jǐn quán lì
ex.en: Do your best in anything you do.

ex.zh: 那个词用意大利语怎么说？
ex.p: nà gè cí yòng yì dà lì yǔ zěn me shuō
ex.en: How do you say that in Italian?

ex.zh: 巴西的首都是巴西利亚。
ex.p: ba xī de shǒu dū shì ba xī lì yà
ex.en: The capital of Brazil is Brasilia.

ex.zh: 这药没有副作用。
ex.p: zhè yào méi yǒu fù zuò yòng
ex.en: This medicine has no side effects.

ex.zh: 假若他在这里，他会说什么？
ex.p: jià ruò tā zài zhè lǐ tā huì shuō shén me
ex.en: If he were here, what would he say?

ex.zh: 我真是欣喜若狂。
ex.p: wǒ zhēn shì xīn xǐ ruò kuáng
ex.en: I'm absolutely elated.

ex.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
ex.p: wèi le cān jiā huá chuán bǐ sài yī zhī xīn de duì wǔ zǔ chéng le
ex.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

ex.zh: 我喜欢在队伍里。
ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan zài duì wǔ lǐ
ex.en: I like being on the team.

ex.zh: 这场革命已经带来了很多改变。
ex.p: zhè cháng gé mìng yǐ jīng dài lái le hěn duō gǎi biàn
ex.en: The revolution has brought about many changes.

ex.zh: “好人不长命”是句或真或假的老话。
ex.p: hǎo rén bù cháng mìng shì gōu huò zhēn huò jià de lǎo huà
ex.en: "The good die young" is an old saying which may or may not be true.

items.en: to recruit; to provoke; to beckon

ex.zh: 汤姆打了个招呼。
ex.p: tāng mǔ dá le gè zhāo hu
ex.en: Tom said hi.

ex.zh: 你在你的床下面藏了多少钱？
ex.p: nǐ zài nǐ de chuáng xià miàn zàng le duō shǎo qián
ex.en: How much money do you have hidden under your bed?

ex.zh: 他藏到一个大石头后面了。
ex.p: tā zàng dào yī gè dà shí tou hòu mian le
ex.en: He hid himself behind a large rock.

ex.zh: 我不喜欢没有英雄的小说。
ex.p: wǒ bù xǐ huan méi yǒu yīng xióng de xiǎo shuō
ex.en: I don't like novels without heroes.

ex.zh: 他梦想着成为一名英雄。
ex.p: tā mèng xiǎng zhe chéng wéi yī míng yīng xióng
ex.en: He dreamed of being a hero.

ex.zh: 他威胁要公开。
ex.p: tā wēi xié yào gōng kāi
ex.en: He threatened to make it public.

items.en: to attack; to accuse; to charge

ex.zh: 发言人的评论极有攻击性。
ex.p: fā yán rén de píng lùn jí yǒu gōng jī xìng
ex.en: The speaker's comments were highly offensive.

ex.zh: 敌人对我们发起了攻击。
ex.p: dí rén duì wǒ men fā qǐ le gōng jī
ex.en: The enemy launched an attack on us.

items.en: to press down; to calm; to subdue

ex.zh: 我不想在城镇的那个地方买房
ex.p: wǒ bù xiǎng zài chéng zhèn de nà gè dì fāng mǎi fáng
ex.en: I wouldn't buy a house in that part of town.

ex.zh: 他比镇里的其他人都有钱。
ex.p: tā bǐ zhèn lǐ de qí tā rén dōu yǒu qián
ex.en: He is richer than anyone else in this town.

ex.zh: 他们不会允许我们进花园的。
ex.p: tā men bù huì yǔn xǔ wǒ men jìn huā yuán de
ex.en: They won't allow us to enter the garden.

ex.zh: 如果天气允许的话，我就去。
ex.p: rú guǒ tiān qì yǔn xǔ de huà wǒ jiù qù
ex.en: I will come, weather permitting.

units.title: 错过、自我、犯
units.intro: HSK 6, words 42–82, most common first. The sentences use characters from this unit and earlier ones, so each unit builds on the last. Finish the lessons, then pass the checkpoint (85%) to open the next unit.

ex.zh: 第一次攻击错过了目标。
ex.p: dì yī cì gōng jī cuò guò le mù biāo
ex.en: The first attack missed the target.

ex.zh: 他可能错过了火车。
ex.p: tā kě néng cuò guò le huǒ chē
ex.en: Perhaps he missed the train.

ex.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
ex.p: zì wǒ huái yí shì cōng ming de dì yī biāo zhì
ex.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.

items.en: to violate; to offend; to assault

ex.zh: 我认为我没犯任何严重的错误。
ex.p: wǒ rèn wéi wǒ méi fàn rèn hé yán zhòng de cuò wù
ex.en: I don't think I've ever made any serious mistakes.

ex.zh: 你每次都继续犯同样的错误。
ex.p: nǐ měi cì dōu jì xù fàn tóng yàng de cuò wù
ex.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.

ex.zh: 她的衣服全部都是她自己做的。
ex.p: tā de yī fu quán bù dōu shì tā zì jǐ zuò de
ex.en: She makes all her own clothes.

ex.zh: 我看到了一个穿黑衣服的女人。
ex.p: wǒ kàn dào le yī gè chuān hēi yī fu de nǚ rén
ex.en: I saw a woman in black.

ex.zh: 一个正确的科学家不会那样想。
ex.p: yī gè zhèng què de kē xué jiā bù huì nà yàng xiǎng
ex.en: A true scientist wouldn't think like that.

ex.zh: 听到这样的消息我真的很难过。
ex.p: tīng dào zhè yàng de xiāo xi wǒ zhēn de hěn nán guò
ex.en: I'm really sorry to hear that.

ex.zh: 你很快就会习惯吃日本料理了。
ex.p: nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn chī rì běn liào lǐ le
ex.en: You'll soon get used to Japanese food.

ex.zh: 她不理他，这被证明是不明智的。
ex.p: tā bù lǐ tā zhè bèi zhèng míng shì bù míng zhì de
ex.en: She ignored him, which proved unwise.

items.en: thigh; part of a whole; portion of a sum

ex.zh: 我爸爸现在非常专注于股市。
ex.p: wǒ bà ba xiàn zài fēi cháng zhuān zhù yú gǔ shì
ex.en: My father is very much involved in the stock market now.

ex.zh: 房里闻起来有股烟味。
ex.p: fáng lǐ wén qǐ lai yǒu gǔ yān wèi
ex.en: The room smelled of tobacco.

items.en: to speak the truth; truth to tell; frankly

ex.zh: 说实话，这对我来说有点太辣了。
ex.p: shuō shí huà zhè duì wǒ lái shuō yǒu diǎn tài là le
ex.en: To tell you the truth, this is a little too spicy for me.

items.en: double-edged sword; classifier for blows of a sword

ex.zh: 他以优异的成绩毕业于剑桥大学。
ex.p: tā yǐ yōu yì de chéng jì bì yè yú jiàn qiáo dà xué
ex.en: He graduated from Cambridge with honors.

items.en: explosion; to explode; to blow up

ex.zh: 当汽车爆炸时，车上只有三名乘客。
ex.p: dāng qì chē bào zhà shí chē shàng zhǐ yǒu sān míng chéng kè
ex.en: There were only three passengers on the bus when it exploded.

ex.zh: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。
